message: Android 0.1.55 (56) is available through the official direct-download lane. Files received in WeChat or another Android app can now be opened or shared to 源图casepro and imported into a searchable case or collection destination. The in-app file menu also separates 从微信添加 from 浏览本机文件. Local private-storage copy, file-size and format validation, duplicate removal, authentication, and rollback protections remain enforced. The exact signed APK passed 765 automated tests, full lint, R8, 16 KiB alignment, and retained-data OPPO verification. Tencent AppBao currently continues to serve 0.1.53 (54); a store update is a separate submission and review.
